premises.text: Existing online formats let people learn from content but do not enable socialization like in-person events
premises.evidence_span: people can learn from great content, but they can't socialize

premises.text: A virtual-event platform places customized avatars in a shared venue where people move and talk in real time
premises.evidence_span: You appear inside of a venue

premises.text: Distributed communities need a way to bring members across cities and countries into the same virtual room
premises.evidence_span: no way to bring them together into the same room

premises.text: Revenue comes from organization monthly venue fees plus a share of ticket sales and virtual sponsorship
premises.evidence_span: charging organizations a monthly fee to have access to our venues

value.text: Virtual events that combine great content learning with real socialization and connections
value.evidence_span: a product that gives the two benefits of why we are all here at this event online

causal_links.evidence_span: The world is missing a product that gives the two benefits
You can move around and actually talk to people
we also take a percentage of ticket sales and virtual sponsorship

notes: Livestream/webinar/AMA list folded into one missing-socialization pain. Multi-hour stay treated as traction/demo evidence, not a premise. Singleton D2/D3 retained as independently revisable product and monetization modules.
